category_title: High-intensity students who rush through tasks and experience math anxiety
minimal_context: The student is using a computer-generated stopwatch to time parachute drops with a Lego man to calculate average descent times.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to calculate the average time it takes for two different kinds of parachutes to reach the ground with the Lego man.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Where’s the stool? Where are the parachutes? What will be attached? A Lego man? Cool!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are the materials: tape, yarn, plastic bags, and a hole punch. Let's get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moving fast through the flurry of materials) How about a hippo? Let’s try a giraffe! Which one will hit the ground faster?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just use the computer-generated stopwatch to time the drops so we can record the times.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Let’s just tie them all together and watch them all crash into the ground at once!

task.content: Calculate the average time it took for two different kinds of parachutes to reach the ground with the courageous Lego man

context.materials: Tape, yarn, Lego characters, hole punch, plastic bags, computer-generated stopwatch

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: The experiment began with a flurry of materials
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He was a ball of action and words, blurting out rapid questions and suggesting to tie them all together and watch them all crash into the ground at once
related_quotes: Where’s the stool? Where are the parachutes? What will be attached? A Lego man? Cool! How about a hippo? Let’s try a giraffe! Which one will hit the ground faster? Let’s just tie them all together and watch them all crash into the ground at once!

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Moving at the speed he loves most: fast!
